name: bolt_bracket_gauge_10
text:
petra 0

# violates: steel.support_side.flange_width
# A bolted bracket whose two bolt columns stand 10 in apart on the flange of a W10x45, which
# is 8.02 in wide: wherever the group is placed, a column of bolts is off the flange.

design "steel-bolt-bracket" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"
}

bolt_bracket bb1 {
  basis lrfd
  plate steel.A36 thickness 0.5 inch
  support W10x45 flange grade steel.A992
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.875 inch threads included
  rows 4
  columns 2
  pitch 3 inch
  gauge 10 inch
  eccentricity 8 inch
  edge_vertical 1.5 inch
  plate_edge 1.5 inch
}

load gravity {
  on bb1 shear in [0 kip, 40 kip]
  signed "s.engineer@example.org" source "beam reaction, LRFD 1.2D + 1.6L, calc SC-3"
}
violations: steel.support_side.flange_width
no placement puts 2 bolt columns at 10 in on the W10x45's 8.02 in flange with every hole clear of its 0.35 in web

name: circuit_16mm2_in_4mm2_terminal
text:
petra 0

# violates: circuit.terminal.conductor_area
# The lighting radial with its 2.5 mm2 cable replaced by 16 mm2, still landed in a lever
# terminal that clamps 0.2 to 4 mm2: the conductor does not fit the terminal.

design "workshop-lighting-radial" {
  owner "e.designer@example.org"
  environment indoor_dry
}

ambient in [10 degC, 40 degC] signed "site.manager@example.org" source "site survey 2026-09"

circuit lighting {
  supply mains voltage 230 V fault_current in [0 kA, 6 kA] signed "dno.liaison@example.org" source "DNO letter 2026-08-14"
  breaker cb1 part mcb.B10
  wire w1 cable cable.cu_pvc_16 length 18 m install install.clipped_direct
  terminal t1 part terminal.lever_4mm2_75C
  consumer lamps

  connect mains.out -> cb1.in
  connect cb1.out -> w1.a
  connect w1.b -> t1.wire
  connect t1.out -> lamps.in
}

load lamp_draw {
  on lighting.lamps current in [0 A, 10 A]
  signed "e.designer@example.org" source "luminaire schedule rev 3"
}

claim hot:  lighting.w1.temperature <= 70 degC under lamp_draw
claim drop: lighting.w1.voltage_drop <= 3 % under lamp_draw
violations: circuit.terminal.conductor_area
16 mm2 conductor in terminal.lever_4mm2_75C, which clamps 0.2 mm2 to 4 mm2 (registry, tagged judged)

name: double_angle_w36_into_w10_web
text:
petra 0

# violates: steel.beam_vs_support.web_clearance
# The double-angle example with a W36x231 beam framed into the web of a W10x45 column: the
# beam's 16.5 in flange cannot pass between flanges 8.86 in apart.

design "steel-double-angle" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"
}

double_angle da1 {
  basis lrfd
  beam W36x231 grade steel.A992
  support W10x45 web grade steel.A992
  angles L4x3_1_2x3_8 grade steel.A36 outstanding long
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.75 inch threads included
  rows 4
  pitch 3 inch
  edge_vertical 1.25 inch
  beam_edge 1.75 inch
  top 3 inch
  beam_gauge 2 inch
  support_side bolted
  support_gauge 5.5 inch
}

load gravity {
  on da1 shear in [0 kip, 60 kip]
  signed "s.engineer@example.org" source "beam reaction, LRFD 1.2D + 1.6L, calc SC-3"
}
violations: steel.beam_side.fillet
angles top edge 1.75 in below the W36x231's top, on its fillet, off the flat web (2.21 in)
steel.support_side.web_fillet
outstanding legs: 8.76 in across, wider than the W10x45's 7.86 in flat web
steel.beam_vs_support.web_clearance
the W36x231's 16.5 in flange is wider than the 8.86 in between the W10x45's flanges, and its end, 0.25 in out, lies inside their tips at 3.835 in

name: seated_6_rows
text:
petra 0

# violates: steel.support_side.leg_length
# The seated example with 6 rows of bolts at 3 in pitch in the seat's vertical leg: the
# L6x4x3/4's leg is 6 in long, and the bottom hole reaches 16.7 in below its heel.

design "steel-seated" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"

seated seat1 {
  basis lrfd
  beam W16x26 grade steel.A992
  support W14x90 flange grade steel.A992

  seat_length 8 inch
  setback 0.5 inch
  support_side bolted
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.75 inch threads included
  rows 6
  pitch 3 inch
  edge_vertical 1.25 inch
  support_gauge 5.5 inch
  top_angle L4x4x1_4 grade steel.A36 outstanding long
}

load gravity {
  on seat1 shear in [0 kip, 30 kip]
  signed "s.engineer@example.org" source "beam reaction, LRFD 1.2D + 1.6L, calc SC-3"
}
violations: steel.support_side.leg_length
bottom bolt hole reaches 16.656 in below the L6x4x3_4's heel, off its 6 in vertical leg

name: shear_end_plate_8_rows
text:
petra 0

# violates: steel.beam_side.depth
# The shear end plate example with 8 rows at 3 in pitch on a W16x31 (d = 15.9 in): the plate
# is 23.5 in long and its welds 23.1 in, against 14.2 in of flat web (d - 2 kdes).

design "steel-shear-end-plate" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"
}

shear_end_plate ep1 {
  basis lrfd
  beam W16x31 grade steel.A992
  support W14x90 flange grade steel.A992
  plate steel.A36 thickness 0.25 inch
  plate_width 8 inch
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.75 inch threads included
  rows 8
  pitch 3 inch
  edge_vertical 1.25 inch
  support_gauge 5.5 inch
  weld electrode.E70 size 0.1875 inch sides 2
}

load gravity {
  on ep1 shear in [0 kip, 50 kip]

violations: steel.beam_side.depth

  rows 8
  pitch 3 inch
  edge_vertical 1.5 inch
  plate_edge 1.5 inch
  bolt_line 3 inch
  beam_edge 1.75 inch
  top 3 inch

}

load gravity {

name: truss_600m_span
text:
petra 0

# violates: truss.self_weight
# The Warren truss example scaled to a 600 m span under 1 to 2 N per top node. Its 250 m
# diagonals of CHS 60.3x3.2 each weigh about 11 kN, which the truss model never loads.

design "warren-footbridge-panel" {
  owner "a.reviewer@example.org"
  environment indoor_dry
}

truss frame {
  material steel.S355
  section chs.60_3x3_2

  node A at (0 m, 0 m) support pinned
  node B at (300 m, 0 m)
  node C at (600 m, 0 m) support roller_x
  node D at (150 m, 200 m)
  node E at (450 m, 200 m)

  member bottom_ab: A -- B
  member bottom_bc: B -- C
  member top_de:    D -- E section chs.76_1x3_2
  member diag_ad:   A -- D
  member diag_db:   D -- B
  member diag_be:   B -- E
  member diag_ec:   E -- C
}

load crowd {
  on frame.D fy in [-2 N, -1 N]
  on frame.E fy in [-2 N, -1 N]
  signed "client.structures@example.org" source "brief rev B, section 3.2"
}

claim strength:   frame.collapse_factor >= 1.5 under crowd
claim stability:  frame.stability_factor >= 3 under crowd
claim stress:     frame.member(diag_ad).stress <= 235 MPa under crowd
violations: truss.self_weight
collapse factor 0 with the members' weight, below the claimed 1.5 (without it 3.109): the truss cannot carry its own weight
